params.val: blocks status moves targeting anyone on this side this turn
the incoming move is not a status move

verified via Showdown source (moves.ts): Crafty Shield's own onTryHit also lets through any move whose target is 'self' or 'all' (e.g. Trick Room, Perish Song, Haze) even though those are status moves — it only blocks status moves that target a specific Pokémon/side. Not folded into the fail_if above since self-targeted moves already can't reach this side's Pokémon regardless; the 'all'-target exception is the one genuine extra carve-out.
shared across the whole protection-move family — reset to 0 on any turn where no protection move was used; success chance next use is (1/3)^protect_streak
